Leadership

How honest leaders build healthy organisations

October 2, 20268 minute read

Many leaders are rewarded for appearing certain long before they actually feel certain. They learn to project confidence, protect their image and carry difficult decisions without allowing anyone to see the weight behind them.

Leadership without performance

From the outside, this can look like strong leadership. Inside an organisation, however, the pressure to perform can create distance, silence and mistrust.

Real leadership creates enough safety for truth to enter the room.
